bullets.title: NVDA: HSBC raises PT to $360, Poolside AI deal ($6B license + $1B investment), China LPU chip denied
bullets.body: HSBC lifted its NVIDIA price target to $360 from $325. Separately, NVIDIA agreed to pay $6B to license AI models from coding startup Poolside and invest an additional $1B at a $12B valuation, while also absorbing most of Poolside's engineering team. NVIDIA simultaneously denied reports of a China-specific LPU product, stating 'NVIDIA has no China-specific LPU product in its roadmap and no LPU sales in China market currently.'

bullets.title: NVDA: Gigabyte desktop PC with GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra ships; NVIDIA China LPU report in conflict with company denial
bullets.body: Gigabyte unveiled a desktop PC using NVIDIA's GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra Desktop Superchip, marketed as a 'data-center-in-a-box' supporting 400 simultaneous user queries. Separately, a report claimed NVIDIA is developing an LPU-based inference chip for China with SMIC as monopoly foundry—directly contradicted by NVIDIA's official denial.

bullets.title: MRVL: Oppenheimer lifts PT to $300; custom silicon thesis reaffirmed with $10B FY29 target
bullets.body: Oppenheimer raised MRVL's price target to $300 from $250. A separate note maintained a Buy rating with a $290 PT based on 20x FY29E EPS of $14.50, citing strong hyperscaler positioning (Google, AWS, MSFT) and DSP ASP upside from shortages. The community is also watching Marvell's Celestia photonic fabric concept but views it as a 2027 story.

bullets.title: MRVL: $1.5B custom silicon business targeting >$10B FY29 revenue; stock 'left for dead' in 2025
bullets.body: One fintwit account noted MRVL's custom silicon grew from ~$1.5B to a >$10B FY29 target after the stock missed the late-2025 optical rally, calling it 'one of more interesting setups over next few years.'

bullets.title: MU: $50B Boise expansion, $10B Research Labs launch; stock up 670% YoY amid AI memory race
bullets.body: Micron CEO announced a $10B Micron Research Labs investment in Boise with a multi-decade horizon. Total Boise commitment is ~$50B, including two new fabs expected to create 17,000+ jobs. Fintwit bullishly notes Micron's long-term investment durability as evidence of structural memory demand confidence; stock cited as up 670% over the past year.

bullets.title: AVGO: Seeking $60B+ in debt for AI chip financing; Anthropic primary beneficiary
bullets.body: Broadcom is in talks to raise more than $60 billion in debt—potentially including a $30B junior tranche—to fund AI chip deals, with Anthropic among key beneficiaries. Reports suggest total potential funding could reach $100B, highlighting the massive capital requirements of the AI buildout.

bullets.title: SNDK: Pricing and volume each ~50% of FY27 Q1 earnings growth per Tianfeng interview
bullets.body: A Tianfeng Securities note summarizing an interview with SanDisk's IR indicated that pricing is a slightly larger contributor to FY27 Q1 earnings growth, with pricing and volume each estimated to account for roughly half of total earnings growth.

bullets.title: NVDA/MU/SNDK/LITE 'Elastic Expectations' report: stronger near-term AI infrastructure demand case
bullets.body: A curated report published August 18, 2026 ('Elastic Expectations') presents a 'materially stronger near-term case for sustained AI infrastructure demand,' flagging NVDA, MU, SNDK, and LITE as key beneficiaries. The same account cautioned that majority of current GAI industry coverage is 'garbage' lacking unique analysis.

bullets.title: Cloud hyperscaler Q2 combined revenue $106.3B, +43% YoY; EBITDA margins seen reaching ~50% by 2030
bullets.body: AWS, Microsoft Intelligent Cloud, and Google Cloud combined Q2 revenue reached approximately $106.3B, up 43% YoY and 15% sequentially. Separately, analysts forecast hyperscaler EBITDA margins rising to roughly 50% by decade-end from ~30% today, a critical assumption underpinning AI capex models.

bullets.title: Taiwan export orders +61.9% YoY to record $97.94B in July; US orders surged 88.9% YoY
bullets.body: Taiwan's July export orders reached a fresh record of $97.94B, up 61.9% YoY and well ahead of the 52.7% forecast. US orders alone surged 88.9% YoY to $40.79B, the fastest growth on record, driven by IT/communications products—a strong forward demand signal for chip and semiconductor supply chains.

bullets.title: Japan chip-making equipment billings +35.4% YoY in July; South Korea DRAM export prices continue rising
bullets.body: Japan chip-making equipment billings surged 35.4% YoY in July per SEAJ, signaling robust semiconductor capex. South Korea's preliminary DRAM export unit prices for August 1-20 also continued to rise, supporting the memory pricing narrative.

bullets.title: CHTR: Charter-Cox merger closes, creating world's largest cable operator with 70M+ locations
bullets.body: Charter Communications completed its merger with Cox, combining to pass over 70 million locations under the Spectrum brand and becoming the world's largest cable operator.

bullets.title: SPOT: Spotify adds $1.5B to share buyback program
bullets.body: Spotify announced an additional $1.5 billion added to its share repurchase program, signaling management confidence in the stock's valuation.

bullets.title: PLTR: Michael Burry re-enters bearish bet with March 2027 OTM puts at $100 strike
bullets.body: Burry reportedly re-entered out-of-the-money put positions on Palantir with March 2027 expiration and strike prices in the low-to-mid $100 range, entering the trade as implied volatility declined.

bullets.title: AMD: Low-volume pullback setting up higher low; technical trader expects move higher
bullets.body: One active technical trader flagged AMD's 'low volume, choppy looking pullback that's starting to set up a Higher Low,' expecting a move higher as early as Friday into next week.

bullets.title: Macro: 30-year Treasury yield hits 5.25%; DXY below 200-day MA; Treasury buyback skepticism dominates
bullets.body: The 30-year Treasury yield climbed 6bp to 5.25% even after Treasury Secretary Bessent announced expanded debt buybacks, with market observers noting yields rose back above pre-announcement levels. The U.S. Dollar Index fell below its 200-day moving average for the first time in 3+ months, and Charlie McElligott publicly mocked the 'cringingly executed' buyback announcement.

bullets.title: Macro: Gold overtakes US Treasuries as top central bank reserve asset; foreign Treasury custody holdings 14-year low
bullets.body: Gold now represents 26.3% of central bank reserves vs. Treasuries at 20.2%, the first time since 1996 gold has overtaken Treasuries. Foreign official Treasury holdings at the Fed fell to $2.6T, a 14-year low, while Japan has dumped $123B in Treasuries since February.

bullets.title: Macro: Diesel crack spread surpasses $100 for first time in history; oil +5% weekly on Iran isolation campaign
bullets.body: Diesel crack spread exceeded $100/bbl for the first time historically. Oil gained more than 5% on the week with Brent above $93 and WTI near $86-$88, driven by Trump administration's threatened 'greatest coordinated economic isolation campaign against Iran' and Iran's Central Bank Governor confirming oil exports have stopped.

bullets.title: Data center political headwinds: Texas halts 1,800 projects; Republican Senate candidate eyes moratorium
bullets.body: Texas Governor Abbott's directive halted up to 1,800 data center projects pending new community guidelines. Separately, Republican US Senate candidate Mike Rogers endorsed a one-year moratorium on new data center construction. One observer compared the speed of the anti-datacenter sentiment shift to major macro events.

bullets.title: AI sector: Goldman Delta One notes frontier lab debate shifting; model economics improving rapidly
bullets.body: Goldman Sachs Delta One desk noted the frontier AI lab debate has 'shifted towards whether growth can sustain elevated expectations' with 'model economics improving at a rapid pace.' Qwen 3.8 cited as demonstrating 'increasingly useful intelligence.' Separately, Goldman research estimated AI job substitution eliminated ~25K jobs/month over the past year while augmentation added back ~9K.
